outcome.answer: The closest matches show that you can use LLMs to extract or generate semantic user profiles and triples, then attach them to a knowledge graph for recommendation [1, 2, 5, 6]. [1] uses LLMs to generate semantic profiles for KG entities and then propagates them through the KG for better matching, while [2] builds personal knowledge graphs by extracting RDF-compliant preference triples from conversational data and evaluates them on downstream recommendation. [5] and [6] focus more on persona-based personalization, using KG-derived summaries or live-generated personas to produce personalized prompts and recommendations rather than explicitly constructing a personal knowledge graph from raw text.
